integrity: A complete finite acyclic matching, exact integer Morse differential, independent modular boundary ranks, and the full signed automorphism traces are reproducible from the attached standalone verifier. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: This exact statement concerns only the ordinary independence complex of GP(9,3). The nine smallest carriers have rational span of rank nine; the integral saturation of that subgroup and shortest supports of the two-dimensional quotient are not determined. No larger generalized Petersen family result is implied.
title: Nine octahedral carriers and a two-dimensional homology deficit in \(\operatorname{Ind}(\mathrm{GP}(9,3))\)
